svg.aria-label: Diagram titled 'Open weights' resolved in three layers when Kimi K3 shipped on July 26 2026, only the first layer is unqualified. Layer 1, the weights: OPEN — 2.8 trillion parameters, about 50 billion active per token, published on Hugging Face as roughly 594 gigabytes in MXFP4, the largest open-weight release in history. Layer 2, the license: RESTRICTED — a bespoke Kimi K3 License, not the Modified MIT claimed earlier; a revenue-triggered separate agreement is required for Model-as-a-Service resale, and any product over 100 million monthly users or 20 million dollars monthly revenue must display 'Kimi K3' in its interface. Layer 3, running it yourself: GATED BY HARDWARE — about a 1.4 terabyte VRAM planning floor to serve, roughly 18 H100 80GB GPUs at 4-bit, with production-stable local inference not expected before Q4 2026. A footer notes that day-zero practical access is still to rent it: 3 dollars and 15 dollars per million tokens on Moonshot's API, hosted same-window by Together AI and Modal.
svg.title: "Open weights" landed in three layers — only the first is unqualified (Kimi K3, Jul 26 2026)
svg.text: The largest open-weight release ever landed — but "open" resolved in three layers
Kimi K3 (Moonshot AI), weights published Jul 26 2026. Only the first layer is unqualified.
2.8T params (~50B active/token) · ~594 GB MXFP4 (QAT from SFT) · on Hugging Face
Largest open-weight release in history · Index #4 at ~57 · #1 Frontend Code Arena
Resolves the Jul-17 → Jul-25 promise: the "open frontier" is genuinely downloadable
Bespoke "Kimi K3 License" (HF license:other) — NOT the "Modified MIT" claimed Jul-17
Revenue-triggered separate agreement to resell as a service; must show "Kimi K3" in
the UI above 100M monthly users or $20M/month revenue
~1.4 TB VRAM planning floor to serve · ~18× H100-80GB at 4-bit · 64+ accelerators
recommended · production-stable local inference is a ~Q4 2026 story for most teams
Day-0 practical access = rent it, not host it:
Moonshot API $3 / $15 per Mtok (~$0.30 cache-hit input) · hosted same-window by Together AI & Modal
